properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-1/SHA-2 family available in the shipped library; ethers v5 uses hash.js's SHA-256 for message hashing (EIP-191). No direct call site in first-party app code — the algorithms ship inside the dependency, reachable via ethers.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dev-toolchain dependency: the ECDSA-secp256k1 signature stack of the Hardhat toolchain (root lockfile only). Every transaction this repo deploys or sends is signed with this curve. The curve choice is fixed by Ethereum itself — no PQ account scheme exists on any Ethereum network yet, so this is observable here but replaceable only by the Ethereum protocol, not by this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: OpenSSL's legacy single-round MD5 KDF, shipped in the dev toolchain via browserify-aes (crypto-browserify shim used by Ethereum JS libraries). No call site in first-party code; it rides along with the browserify crypto polyfill. Rating C is retroactive-risk, but reachability here is dev-tooling-only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The frontend dapp's ECDSA engine: elliptic@6.5.4 via @ethersproject/signing-key (ethers v5.4.7 runtime dependency). Used for secp256k1 key operations whenever ethers runs in-page (signature recovery, address derivation); live transaction signing is additionally delegated to the MetaMask extension. Curve is fixed by Ethereum — replaceable only upstream.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDH capability of the shipped elliptic library; the dapp never performs an ECDH agreement (its only key agreement is delegated to MetaMask inside the wallet extension). Presence is the inventory fact: the algorithm ships to every browser that loads this bundle's node_modules tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 capability of tweetnacl 0.14.5, present in the dev toolchain for sshpk's OpenSSH key-format handling. No application call site; the version is fixed by upstream (bcrypt-pbkdf/sshpk), replaceable only by the vendor.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ethereum's core hash: @ethersproject/keccak256 powers every address derivation, tx id and ABI encoding this dapp computes (both the Hardhat toolchain and the frontend runtime). Low PQ urgency — Grover gives only a square-root speedup on preimages; also note Ethereum uses the original Keccak padding, not the NIST SHA3-256 variant.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 in this repo ships via three packages: @ethersproject/pbkdf2 (ethers v5's PBKDF2 module — a runtime dependency of the frontend's ethers@5.4.7, dev-only in the root toolchain's ethers@5.7.2), pbkdf2@3.1.2 (the node implementation @ethersproject/pbkdf2 wraps), and @types/pbkdf2. PBKDF2 itself is quantum-safe (password KDF); iteration counts would be set at call sites, none of which exist in this boilerplate's application code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Memory-hard password KDF: scrypt-js 3.0.1 in the frontend is @ethersproject/scrypt (ethers v5 encrypted-keystore wallet support); root copies arrive via ethereum-cryptography, eth-gas-reporter and ethers. Not Shor-relevant (symmetric primitive), so low PQ urgency — the inventory value is knowing it ships.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES available in the shipped node-forge library (webpack-dev-server's PKI helper for local HTTPS dev certs under react-scripts 5.0.1). No AES call site in application code; dev-only dependency.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl's authenticated-encryption primitive (secretbox/box), shipped in the dev toolchain via sshpk. No application call site; ships with the dependency tree. AE primitives are not Shor-relevant.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dev-only asset, changeable here: webpack-dev-server generates a throwaway self-signed X.509 certificate for the local HTTPS dev server. Never used in production; the cert is regenerated on demand and trusted only by the developer's own browser session.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dev-only PKI machinery: node-forge's X.509 implementation is what selfsigned@2.0.1 uses to build the throwaway dev-server certificate. Changeable here (react-scripts dev server config); no production impact.
